observations.title: Missing backups
observations.text: I run nightly database backups for our app. They stopped last week and I only noticed when I checked the bucket. How do you get alerted when a backup never runs?

observations.title: Checking imports by hand
observations.text: Every morning I open the logs to see if our overnight customer import finished. I want a simple alert if it has not completed by 7am.

observations.title: Website uptime
observations.text: I need a service to request our homepage every minute and alert me when the HTTP response is not 200. We do not have background jobs.
